messages:
Nora (CS): Heads-up: VitalFlux wants a short LATAM allowlist + QPS bump for a partner onboarding demo next week. They expect bursty inference from 18:00-20:00 BRT. Renewal check-in is in ~30 days, so this is a good opportunity to prove stability.

Diego (Acct Exec): They flagged concerns about Sao Paulo latency in the onboarding survey. If we can guarantee region routing and a clean demo, it helps the renewal convo. I'll be on the call.

Priya (SRE): What exact IPs do they need allowed? Do we want region pin to sa-east-1 or do they need multi-AZ?

Nora (CS): Partner proxy NATs: 198.51.100.128/30 and 203.0.113.16/28. They may add one ephemeral IP but will stay in those CIDRs. Window: 2026-04-12T21:00:00Z -> 2026-04-13T01:00:00Z (4h). QPS target 180, burst 350. Customer: VF-1092. They will send X-VF-Token header for auth.

Omar (Solutions): Recommend warming KV cache and enabling a short (5m) traffic ramp. I can push a small harness to hit common prompts and share the link. Also let's record p95 latency and error rate for SLAs.

Priya (SRE): I'll prepare an ephemeral policy: region_pin sa-east-1, allowlist those CIDRs, rate qps 180, burst 350, auto-revoke after window. Will run a 5m canary 30m before start. Need approval to apply canary.

Nora (CS): Approve canary. Please include a rollback threshold: p95 > 200ms or error rate > 1% during canary.

Priya (SRE): Ack. Config payload I'm going to apply: ```json
{
  "customer_id":"VF-1092",
  "region_pin":"sa-east-1",
  "allowlist":["198.51.100.128/30","203.0.113.16/28"],
  "rate_limits":{"qps":"180","burst":"350"},
  "start":"2026-04-12T21:00:00Z",
  "end":"2026-04-13T01:00:00Z",
  "canary":{"duration":"5m","start_offset":"30m","rollback_p95_ms":200,"rollback_error_pct":1},
  "notes":"4h ephemeral LATAM onboarding demo; auto-revoke; warmup recommended"
}
```

infra-bot: Received apply request. Ticket CS-7104 created. Initiating canary in sa-east-1 at 6172950215. Requestor: Priya.

Priya (SRE): Canary running now. Quick smoke looks fine (p95 98ms, errors 0.1%).

Priya (SRE): Canary success. Rolling to full apply for VF-1092. Applied at 6172950450.

Nora (CS): Thanks team :rocket: I'll message VitalFlux with the window and the token header reminder. Diego  can you draft a short renewal note tying success metrics to our renewal proposal? Omar  please share the warmup harness link and schedule.

Diego (Acct Exec): Yep, drafting renewal note. Will propose a 12-month discount if demo meets p95 < 130ms and error < 0.5% over 24h post-demo.

Omar (Solutions): Warmup harness uploaded to /shared/cs/warmups/VF-1092 and I scheduled warmup 45m before start. Link: https://internal.storage/warmups/VF-1092

Nora (CS): Loop closed. Keeping this ephemeral and auto-revoked after the window. Will follow up with telemetry summary after demo.
